decisions.name: Centerville Schwan Park official dock
decisions.rationale: TECHE Project identifies the official National Paddle Trail dock at Schwan Park, 514 Parish Road 131, Centerville. Current Google Maps aerial imagery shows the park-side landing at the Bayou Teche edge. The old point was about 253 feet from mapped water and 408 feet from the matched flowline; the selected point lies on mapped water. The exact coordinate is imagery-derived, not published or surveyed by TECHE.

postCorrectionAudit.severity: review for all 3 due to generalized/incomplete NHD flowline coverage

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if TECHE or the managing authority relocates or closes the dock, or publishes an exact surveyed coordinate.
